name: kafka-python-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is kafka-python, a pure-Python client for Apache Kafka. Its two client APIs are
`KafkaConsumer`, which subscribes to topics or takes manually assigned partitions, joins consumer groups through
a group coordinator and fetches records, and `KafkaProducer`, which serializes, partitions, batches and sends
records and reports each result through a future.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this part of the repository.
Everything in scope is kafka-python's two client APIs, KafkaConsumer and KafkaProducer: the consumer package (kafka/consumer/ except kafka/consumer/__main__.py; it holds KafkaConsumer, the fetcher and the subscription state), the group-coordinator package (kafka/coordinator/, including the partition assignors), the producer package (kafka/producer/ except kafka/producer/__main__.py; it holds KafkaProducer, its record accumulator, sender, transaction manager and futures), the partitioners (kafka/partitioner/), the serializers (kafka/serializer/), kafka/structs.py and the consumer and producer command-line interfaces (kafka/cli/consumer/ and kafka/cli/producer/), together with README.rst, docs/index.rst, docs/high_level.rst, docs/upgrade_to_3_0.rst, the API reference pages docs/apidoc/KafkaConsumer.rst and docs/apidoc/KafkaProducer.rst, the docs/apidoc/misc/ pages for ConsumerRebalanceListener, ConsumerRecord, FutureRecordMetadata, IsolationLevel, OffsetAndMetadata, Partitioner, RecordMetadata, Serializer and TopicParti
